first_step_test: A broad palm with rounded fingertip fixes the mitten scale and leaves an opening for the thumb and cuff.

source.notes: Six-panel felt-tip contact sheet; review before crop.

final_elements.name: rounded palm
final_elements.description: Draw the rounded fingertip arch and right palm edge; stop the short left edge at the future thumb join, leaving the wrist open.

final_elements.name: left thumb
final_elements.description: From the open left endpoint, loop the thumb outward and back down toward the wrist, leaving both wrist ends open.

final_elements.name: ribbed cuff
final_elements.description: Across the open wrist, add a wide rectangular cuff joined to both lower palm ends.

final_elements.name: cuff divider
final_elements.description: Draw one horizontal line through the cuff, making two parallel cuff bands.

final_elements.name: three palm stitches
final_elements.description: Place exactly three short dash stitches in a shallow curve across the palm.
